title: fix(setup): permission set field rows leave out the platform's bookkeeping columns
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8611re6sGxojaV3xm86DkjY)_
Fixes #27404

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Setup 权限集展开对象后的字段行,不再列出平台记账列(`__search`、`organization_id`、`owning_business_unit_id`),判据沿用 Studio 数据栏的 `isStudioHiddenSystemField`(system 且 hidden)。
- 为什么改:原来字段行列出合并定义里的全部字段并按名排序,“Search Index (`__search`)” 排在第一,管理员看到的是平台内部列而不是对象自己的字段。
- 风险与回滚:只改显示与批量按钮的作用范围,保存写法不变;已存有条目的记账列照旧显示;回滚即还原 `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` 一个文件。
- 先看:`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` 里 `FieldsSubTable` 的 `offered` 过滤;同文件 `ensureFields` 带上 system/hidden;`PermissionMatrixEditor.systemFields-27404.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.systemFields-27404.test.tsx`,预期 5 passed。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `FieldSummary` keeps the served definition's `system` and `hidden` marks; `ensureFields` reads them as booleans (`=== true`, the spec declares both `z.boolean()`).
- `FieldsSubTable` draws the **offered** rows: every field except one `isStudioHiddenSystemField` holds for, imported from `views/studio-design/studioHiddenSystemField.ts` (untouched). No second predicate, no name list.
- A bookkeeping column the set already carries an entry for still draws as written: an entry in the draft, or in the last loaded/saved set (`baselineFieldKeys`, set where the dirty baseline is re-anchored). So a Clear on such a row keeps the row on screen until that save lands.
- The count, the filter threshold, the empty state and the three bulk shortcuts read the offered rows, so Read-only all / Write all / Clear never write an entry for a column the admin cannot see.
- The row-condition editor's `fieldNames` stays the full field list, so a `when` naming a left-out column is not linted as unknown. `loadObjectFields` (the RLS CEL editor) is untouched: it feeds lint and autocomplete only and offers no picker.

## Why

The ruling on the card: the platform's bookkeeping columns are the fields where `system` AND `hidden` hold together (`isStudioHiddenSystemField`, objectui#11780); they are dropped from offered field lists, and a value already stored against one still draws as written (objectui#13152 CONTROL). This editor was the one field list that did not apply it.

## Tests

New `PermissionMatrixEditor.systemFields-27404.test.tsx` (package door, served definition with `__search` and `organization_id` marked system + hidden, `owner_id` system only, `internal_notes` hidden only):

- `__search` and `organization_id` are not offered; the count reads `4 / 4`.
- CONTROL: the author-hidden field and the system `owner_id` still draw, rows in name order.
- CONTROL: a stored `__search` entry draws as written (Read off, a rule, not inherited).
- CONTROL: Clear on that stored row keeps it until the autosave lands; the saved body has no `__search` entry, after which the column is no longer offered.
- Read-only all writes entries for the four offered fields only.

Ablation (fix committed first, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the predicate term of the `offered` filter, replaced by `true ||`): anchor 1 → 0, all 5 tests red, restore verified blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. The three CONTROL cases go red too, because each pins the exact row list, which the ablation widens.

## Acceptance notes

- Once a save drops the last stored entry for a bookkeeping column, the row leaves the list (on the package door, at autosave). That is the ruling read literally: nothing is stored any more, so nothing is drawn as written.
- The predicate is imported from `studio-design/`, as `FlowReferenceField` in this same `metadata-admin/` tree already does.
- os-dev exception: the PR template's headings are folded into the os-dev section order.
